lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: All of it. Every derivation, in order, including the four I was wrong about, which are the useful ones.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: They did not burn these because they are dangerous. They burned them because storage costs money and nobody signed for the crate. That is somehow worse.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Take the slate too. It was in the crate and it is not on any manifest, so as far as this camp is concerned it does not exist.
